newsitem.title: JAPAN: Pioneer to form optical disc unit in Spain.
newsitem.headline: Pioneer to form optical disc unit in Spain.

text.p: Pioneer Electronic Corp said on Wednesday it will form an optical disc manufacturing and sales company in Spain.
Pioneer Optical Disc Europe SA, to be located in Barcelona, will be a joint venture between two existing Pioneer units, one in Spain and the other in Japan, it said in a statement.
It did not say when the new company will be formed.
The move was prompted by anticipated high demand for digital video discs (DVDs) to be launched next year, Pioneer said.
Until demand for DVDs grows, the new company will produce and sell recordable compact discs, Pioneer said.
Production at the new company is scheduled to begin next March with an initial capacity of 400,000 discs per month, Pioneer said.
